title: Panic Returns To The AI Trade, Oil Surges Past $100, Here Are The BEST Trades
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: Fear over indebted, unprofitable AI infrastructure names (CoreWeave, a collapsing Korean IPO) is valid but creates buying opportunities at extreme fear.
80% of Americans feel in recession; AI capex and the stock market keep the top 20% spending, so an AI rollover would mean a full recession.
No deal before the midterms makes further US escalation likely, pushing oil higher.
Companies that don't raise guidance are getting sold even on beats (GM).

calls.condition: Only if CRWV drops straight down into 53-51 this week; not if it chops sideways or bounces first
calls.reason: Descending trend line (~53), gap fill at 51 and the 0.886 Fib retrace at 51 give three confluent factors for a bounce trade with 70-75%+ odds; buy extreme AI-debt fear.
calls.quote: my game plan on this is to start nibbling around 53 all the way down to 51, looking for a bounce.

calls.condition: If the near-term key line breaks, door opens to 7,450; upside capped around 8,000
calls.reason: AI-debt fear (CoreWeave) and oil back above $100 pressuring futures; 7,450 is proven long-term support and 8,000 is a multi-year trend-line resistance.
calls.quote: If we break this key line, we likely can open the door to falling all the way down to this 7450 level on the S&P 500.

calls.condition: If the AI trade keeps crumbling and drags the economy into recession
calls.reason: Stock market/AI capex is propping up the economy; an AI rollover would hit the wealthy 20%'s spending, cause recession and push rates down.
calls.quote: when the economy struggles and we go into recessions, what do interest rates do? They tend to go down.

calls.reason: Continued Middle East escalation (US strikes on Iran, Strait blocked); without a deal before the midterms the US has little reason not to escalate, so oil has been creeping up into the midterms.
calls.quote: that's probably why oil has been creeping up into the midterms now, is because it's looking less and less likely that there will be a deal

calls.reason: Broke its ascending channel, retraced to resistance and rejected, so earnings drop was expected; 285 (gap fill and pivot low) is where he'd consider a day trade.
calls.quote: This would have to probably fall all the way down into this 285 level area.

calls.condition: Daily close with confirmation below the trend line tomorrow = breakdown
calls.reason: Good earnings and $20B buyback but no guidance raise with stock near multi-year highs; already below intraday trend line; 75 is a day-tradeable level.
calls.quote: a daily close with confirmation tomorrow on this and you'd have a breakdown on GM.

calls.reason: Strong defense earnings, stock flat to up; no trade because of low volatility; a daily close below ~182 trend line would signal a breakdown.
calls.quote: Basically, a daily close with confirmation below right now about $182 per share.

calls.condition: If today confirms the breakdown: 3,950 first target, then 3,500
calls.reason: Gold kept closing on then below the line, an unhealthy pattern pointing to a confirmed breakdown.
calls.quote: you guys know my levels, 3950 first target. If it breaks that, we're likely headed to 3500.

calls.condition: Below $60 likely heads to 50; reclaiming 60 could send it higher
calls.reason: Silver has already broken down, though recent price action has been slightly positive.
calls.quote: silver's still broken down, so it likely is headed to 50

calls.reason: Repeated hammering on the support line weakens it like a hammer on a floor.
calls.quote: Breaks 81,000, likely 75 is your next level.

notes: No explicit date spoken; dated 2026-10-20 from context (Netflix and SpaceX report 'after the bell' today, GE/RTX/GM/3M reported this morning), same day as the Oct 20 SpaceX/Netflix reports (listing approx 2026-10-21). CRWV entry 52 is the midpoint of the 53-51 buy zone; 59 is pre-market. GM '7650' read as $76.50. Nat gas discussed but no directional view, so skipped.
